summary: The PR adds functionality to check local links in addition to external links, which resolves the reported issue. However, there are some minor style and readability concerns.

issues.description: The class name change from `CheckExternalLinksBuilder` to `CheckLinksBuilder` might be confusing as it no longer indicates that it checks only external links. It could be better named to reflect both external and internal link checking.
The comment `# iterate over reference nodes and image nodes` is redundant as the loop structure is self-explanatory. Removing it would improve readability.
